mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_payment_issue_alert_delivery_rate_bucket ( provider_code, channel_code, window_started_at, used_count, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{providerCode}, #{channelCode}, NOW(), 0, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_issue_alert_delivery_rate_bucket SET used_count = CASE WHEN window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE used_count + 1 END, window_started_at = CASE WHEN window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) THEN NOW() ELSE window_started_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE provider_code = #{providerCode} AND channel_code = #{channelCode} AND ( window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) OR used_count < #{maxDeliveries} )
